policy: Legacy 3O elements that predate v3.0 are recorded here and NOT refactored during WAVE B-G. A new element must never appear in this ledger. Each allowlist entry is validated for freshness: a recorded violation that stops being observed is a hard failure so the ledger can only shrink.

check_oprim_keyword_only.rule: New oprim primitives must be keyword-only (SPEC v3.0 4.2). Legacy primitives listed below predate v3.0 and keep their positional signatures until LEGACY_3O_V3_COMPLIANCE_AUDIT.
